bots.name: Martin
bots.description: Martin learned chess so that he could play with his young kids. He still wins against them most of the time. See how you stack up.

bots.name: Wayne
bots.description: Wayne just learned how the queen moves and he loves to use it.

bots.name: Fabian
bots.description: Fabian thinks playing chess is just like running a country - how hard can that be?

bots.name: Juan
bots.description: Juan thinks he's a great chess player, but he hasn't studied the game very much. Try to prove him wrong.

bots.name: Filip
bots.description: Filip enjoys a game of chess after a hard day's work. He's here to relax and have a fun game.

bots.name: Elani
bots.description: Elani always keeps a straight face, even when she loses a piece. Was it a blunder or a sneaky sacrifice?

bots.name: Noel
bots.description: Noel was born on Christmas and likes to accept presents from his opponents. Keep your pieces safe and you should do OK.

bots.name: Oliver
bots.description: Oliver enjoys chess, but gets confused when there are lots of tactics. He wants to keep things simple, so you might want to mix things up against him.

bots.name: Milica
bots.description: Milica recently beat her dad at chess for the first time. Can you do any better than her dad did?

bots.name: Aron
bots.description: Aron lives in Reykjavik, where Bobby Fischer became World Champion. He hopes to play like Fischer someday, but he still has a long way to go.

bots.name: Janjay
bots.description: Janjay loves going for her opponent's king even if she loses pieces. She doesn't win every game, but she always makes it exciting.

bots.name: Mina
bots.description: Mina loves to play chess with her friends after school. She knows how to make forks with her queen and will catch you with one if you're not careful.

bots.name: Zara
bots.description: Zara loves to play creative chess games and come up with her own ideas. Be careful or she'll trick you with her unique tactics.

bots.name: Santiago
bots.description: Santiago is new to the game, but he's already a very careful player. You'll have to be tricky to outwit him.

bots.name: Karim
bots.description: Karim loves moving the f-pawn to give his king breathing room. He knows it’s a risky strategy, but few opponents can prove it.

bots.name: Maria
bots.description: Maria loves to sacrifice and attack. Don't accept too many of her gifts because there are often strings attached.

bots.name: Maxim
bots.description: Maxim is new to chess, but learning quickly. Try to beat him now while you still can.

bots.name: Hans
bots.description: Hans loves to listen to music while he plays. Try to put your full attention into the game and find a way to win.

bots.name: Azeez
bots.description: Azeez has a big smile and loves to play chess. He likes to think for himself, so expect something offbeat.

bots.name: Laura
bots.description: Laura loves Judit Polgar's games and tries to play like her idol whenever she can. Expect some aggressive tactics and try to hang on.

bots.name: Sven
bots.description: Sven hates to lose pieces and likes to play defensively. Can you show him why it helps to be a bit more balanced?

bots.name: Emir
bots.description: Emir taught his kids how to play chess and hasn't lost a game to them yet. See if you can show them how to do it.

bots.name: Elena
bots.description: Elena coaches an elementary school chess club. None of the kids have beaten her yet. Can you?

bots.name: Wilson
bots.description: How's your endgame? Wilson loves to queen pawns and hopes to beat you to the punch!

bots.name: Vinh
bots.description: Vinh loves outdoor sports, but when the weather is bad, he plays chess instead. He frequently scores goals with the King's Indian.

bots.name: Nelson
bots.description: Nelson knows that the queen is the best piece and he likes to attack with it as much as he can. Most opponents can't punish his risky play. Can you?

bots.name: Jade
bots.description: Jade's coach has taught her some aggressive openings. Be careful early on or you won't have a chance.

bots.name: David
bots.description: David loves to have fun and surprise his opponents. Pay close attention or he might just unleash an attack out of nowhere.

bots.name: Ali
bots.description: Ali hasn't been playing for long, but he's improving quickly. He's been studying old games and developing a positional style.

bots.name: Mateo
bots.description: Mateo doesn't like to get attacked, so don't be surprised if he trades queens and tries to squeeze you in the ending.

bots.name: Wendy
bots.description: Wendy likes to play chess in front of the fireplace. She'll sometimes throw some of her pieces into the fire of her attack, so be careful.

bots.name: Antonio
bots.description: Antonio prides himself on being a balanced player. He doesn't win every game, but don't expect to beat him without a fight.

bots.name: Pierre
bots.description: His coach told him not to move the f-pawn, but Pierre likes to try everything out for himself. Be ready for a tricky game.

bots.name: Pablo
bots.description: Pablo is his local club champion, so he's gotten a bit cocky. He'll try to catch you in the opening with gambits, so be careful.

bots.name: Joel
bots.description: Joel is a solid player who likes playing blitz more than studying. He plays the King's Indian Attack without worrying about theory.

bots.name: Isabel
bots.description: Isabel has been studying endgames with her Grandmaster coach. You might want to beat her now before she gets any better!

bots.name: Arthur
bots.description: Arthur's been playing chess for a long time with his family. They all have different styles, so he's become quite a balanced and careful player.

bots.name: Jonas
bots.description: He has such a friendly smile - and then Jonas comes at you with crazy, aggressive moves. Good luck!

bots.name: Isla
bots.description: Isla loves to attack in the opening, but if you take the initiative, she'll switch gears and defend for as long as it takes.

bots.name: Lorenzo
bots.description: Lorenzo loves a good attack. He's won many nice games that way, so make sure to keep your king safe.

bots.name: Wally
bots.description: Wally loves the time he gets to spend at the chess board. He won't mind playing a long endgame as long as he gets to play.

bots.name: Julia
bots.description: Julia is Dutch, and will enjoy outmaneuvering you in the Dutch!

bots.name: Miguel
bots.description: Miguel is a universal player who focuses on tactics and endgames. If you want to win, you'll need to practice every part of your game!

bots.name: Xavier
bots.description: Xavier loves to take breaks from his studies to play a few games. He's often in a hurry, so he'll try to sacrifice and checkmate as fast as he can.

bots.name: Olga
bots.description: Olga is self taught, so her openings are a bit unusual. But, she knows her tactics and won't lose without a fight.

bots.name: Li
bots.description: Li is her school champion and is quickly getting better. She loves to win short, attacking games.

bots.name: Charles
bots.description: Charles loves a good game of chess after work. He doesn't have time to study too much these days, but he hasn't forgotten how to play a nice tactic.

bots.name: Fatima
bots.description: Calm, patient, and determined to queen! Fatima will grind you down and happily win the endgame.

bots.name: Manuel
bots.description: Manuel is a romantic, and enjoys studying and reviewing the classic games and openings of the past.

bots.name: Oscar
bots.description: Oscar is a good player who admires former World Champion Petrosian. He defends carefully and rarely loses.

bots.name: Nora
bots.description: Nora studied the games of Magnus Carlsen. She's learned from his tactics but hasn't mastered his patience. Watch out for her queen!

bots.name: Noam
bots.description: Noam is a veteran player who has played many icons throughout chess history. He plays solidly, so be prepared for a long fight.

bots.name: Ahmed
bots.description: "F-pawn Ahmed" loves to play the Dutch and attack with as many pieces as he can. He's his local club champion, so you better come prepared.

bots.name: Sakura
bots.description: Sakura is a professor and plays chess like a science. She loves to reach endgames where she can pick her opponents apart.

bots.name: Arjun
bots.description: Arjun's first moves will put you out of your comfort zone, and then his accurate play will push you off the board!

bots.name: Francis
bots.description: Don't let his friendly demeanor off the board lull you to sleep! Francis is a vicious attacker and will checkmate you the first chance he gets.

bots.name: Sofia
bots.description: Sofia is a young rising star! She defends like a pro, but you better beat her now because she may be World Champion in a few years.

bots.name: Alexander
bots.description: Alexander is all strengths and no weaknesses. He wants to be World Chess Champion one day!

bots.name: Luke
bots.description: Being slowly squeezed by Luke is no fun. Well, not for you, at least.

bots.name: Wei
bots.description: Don't be fooled by Wei's smile - she is looking to knock you out from move one. Be careful!

bots.name: Jimmy
bots.description: Jimmy wants to make sure you enjoy the game. He'll adapt to make it a little easier, or a little harder, depending on how you play.

bots.name: Nisha
bots.description: Nisha is a friendly person who plays a little defensively and enjoys playing with people at all levels.

bots.name: Tomas
bots.description: Tomas will give almost anyone a good game, and a tough positional battle!

bots.name: Devon
bots.description: Devon loves to play aggressively... but if he gets the upper-hand, he'll go easy on you.

bots.name: Natasha
bots.description: Natasha always wants to win! But she's not totally heartless - she'll ease up sometimes too.

bots.name: Aerial Powers
bots.description: Aerial Powers is a WNBA champion and former All-American. Watch out — she’s just as dangerous on the chess board as she is on the court!

bots.name: Justin Reid
bots.description: Justin Reid is a 2x Super Bowl winning safety, the winner of BlitzChamps III, and the founder of the JReid Indeed Foundation.

bots.description: Kevin Bordi is a strong French master and a very popular chess personality. His blitz rating on Chess.com has been over 2900, so watch out!

bots.name: Ben Finegold
bots.description: Grandmaster Ben Finegold is a renowned chess educator and streamer. Good luck beating this quick-witted king of the board.

bots.name: Luison
bots.description: Luis “Luison” Fernandez Siles is a Spanish master and popular chess personality. Watch out for his aggressive and tactical style!

bots.name: Krikor
bots.description: Krikor Mekhitarian is a grandmaster and two-time Brazilian Champion. Be careful of his positional skills, or you may find yourself in a bind!

bots.name: FunMasterMike
bots.description: Mike Klein is an American FIDE master and the face of ChessKid.com. Can you beat FunMasterMike in a game?

bots.name: Pandolfini
bots.description: Bruce Pandolfini is an American national master, chess author, columnist, and world-renowned coach. Can you beat this legendary chess teacher?

bots.name: Pia Cramling
bots.description: Pia Cramling is a Swedish Grandmaster and former #1 ranked woman in the world. Can you defeat this 3-time Olympiad gold medalist?

bots.name: Phiona
bots.description: Phiona Mutesi is a woman candidate master who lived in Katwe, a Ugandan slum, and changed her life through chess. Can you defeat the Queen of Katwe?

bots.name: Dawid
bots.description: Dawid Czerw jest polskim IM-em, który obecnie zajmuje się streamowaniem, tworzeniem kursów i popularyzowaniem szachów w Internecie. Czy jesteś w stanie go pokonać?

bots.name: The Mechanical Turk
bots.description: Created in 1770, The Mechanical Turk was the first ever chess robot. But it has a secret...there's a famous chess player hidden inside!
